payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team of daily-life specialists for a vacation-rental dispute and rebooking case for Harper Quill. The team must complete these MANDATORY steps: 1. review the customer's travel timing and address/access context plus the provided property-condition photos and host chat screenshot, 2. search and compare replacement travel or rental bundles that fit the active trip window and budget, 3. review the leading option and send a bounded provider clarification about late arrival or access-code timing if needed, 4. verify the selected replacement plan fits the active budget/coverage limits, 5. authorize the approved payment path and submit the new service request, 6. return a concise customer-facing rebooking summary.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- replacement bundle options and provider notes: Structured comparison sheet of current replacement bundle candidates, including prices, availability freshness, and check-in/access constraints. Extracted content: Replacement Bundle Options AND Provider Notes Structured comparison sheet of current replacement bundle candidates, including prices, availability freshness, and check-in/access constraints. Details Document Title Replacement Bundle Options and Provider Notes Request Id DL-012 Customer Id DL-CUST-012 Comparison Date 2025-06-18 Active Trip Window check-in 2025-06-18 to check-out 2025-06-21 Target City/Area Nashville, TN Maximum Preferred Total Bundle Budget USD 1,150 Option A Provider Riverfront Suites + SwiftRide Airport Transfer Option A Total Price USD 1,042 Option A Availability Last Verified 2025-06-18 10:15 AM local time Option A Check-In/Access Note self check-in available after 4:00 PM with keypad code released on day of arrival Option B Provider Midtown Lodge + CityCab Roundtrip Transfer Option B Total Price USD 978 Option B Check-In/Access Note front desk staffed until 11:00 PM; photo ID and credit card required at check-in Recommended Leading Option Option A Additional Information a realistic 2-page structured travel comparison document using ReportLab a trip summary box, then a main comparison table with multiple replacement bundle options shown in columns or stacked sections a provider notes section beneath the table summarizing practical arrival details and any concerns about late arrival, self check-in, host/front-desk contact, and baggage timing On page 2, include a short analyst notes section and a compact legend explaining freshness and access labels Use realistic typography, light table gridlines, footer page numbers, and a generated-on timestamp This report is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- budget coverage and payment authorization: Coverage memo and authorization sheet defining the active reimbursement cap, approved payment path, and submission requirements for the rebooking. Extracted content: Budget Coverage AND Payment Authorization Coverage memo and authorization sheet defining the active reimbursement cap, approved payment path, and submission requirements for the rebooking. Details Document Title Budget Coverage and Payment Authorization Request Id DL-012 Customer Id DL-CUST-012 Authorization Memo Date 2025-06-18 Active Reimbursement Cap USD 1,200 Approved Immediate Booking Amount up to USD 1,150 Customer Out-Of-Pocket Limit Before Approval USD 0 Approved Payment Path provider-direct payment by support team when available; otherwise customer pay-and-submit for reimbursement Reimbursement Submission Deadline within 14 calendar days of booking Required Submission Documents itemized receipt, booking confirmation, and proof of payment Non-Covered Items minibar purchases, room service, entertainment, optional upgrades, and personal shopping Escalation Required If Total Exceeds Cap By more than USD 50 Authorization Status approved for bounded provide option review and rebooking support Additional Information a realistic 1- to 2-page authorization memo document using ReportLab a clearly labeled table or checklist for covered versus non-covered expenses, submission requirements, deadline, and escalation rules a short notes paragraph clarifying that replacement rebooking support is bounded by the stated cap and documentation requirements Use subtle gray dividers, consistent section headings, footer pagination, and a small confidentiality note at the bottom This report is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
